company_info.description: e'grand Co.,Ltd engages in the used housing renovation business in Japan. The company also purchase used condominiums and detached houses on a unit-by-unit basis for renovation. In addition, it is involved in real estate rental and resort businesses. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. As of May 18, 2026, e'grand Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Seibu Real Estate Inc.
